## AI & Technology Industry

The AI sector continues to dominate Hacker News discussions, with Anthropic surpassing OpenAI to become the world's most valuable AI startup, sparking debate about market dynamics and valuation metrics. Simultaneously, concerns about AI accessibility are surfacing as corporate America begins rationing AI services amid skyrocketing costs, reflecting a broader industry reckoning with sustainability and practical deployment. These stories highlight the tension between rapid innovation and economic realities in the rapidly evolving artificial intelligence landscape.

The proposed new US funding rules allowing grant cancellation at any time raised questions about research stability and academic freedom.
